verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a public REST API with an access-token quickstart and per-endpoint references covering tests, controls, contracts (with stated rate limits), documents, evidence, and audits. It also offers webhooks, OpenAPI-generated SDKs, and agent-friendly llms.txt and .md docs, which probes confirmed are live (HTTP 200). Missing for 10: a publicly fetchable OpenAPI spec (probed paths returned 404), independent or hands-on corroboration of real API usage, and SDKs beyond the Auditor API.
